sources.quote: HD 1502 is an 8th-magnitude K-type subgiant star in the constellation of Pisces, located at a distance of approximately 630 light-years.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 5.6 solar radii and 2.05 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,043 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
